maintenance_led.reason: Contract manufacturer of new medical device components and finished devices (catheters, cardiac rhythm, neuromodulation) for OEMs; not repair or aftermarket.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private medical device OEMs; revenue comes from them, not directly from government payers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through OEM outsourcing programs and own product development; acquisitions are occasional, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Components and devices are qualified into customers' regulated medical products; switching requires re-validation and regulatory approval.
